name: Hair salon

pf.license.need: always: hair work (cosmetology or hairstyling) is licensed where the state's rules require it
pf.license.who: both: the salon holds a salon license, and each stylist holds their own
pf.license.ask: the salon's license number; each stylist's number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.away: work at the customer's home or a venue only where the state's rules allow hair work away from a licensed salon; some states ask for an extra permit or a booking made through a licensed salon (a switch from the state form)
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it
pf.license.booth: a booth renter is their own business: their own license (and a renter's license where the state issues one), prices and Stripe
pf.license.makeup: makeup is its own kind of work, with its own license where the state asks

pf.services.shape: set services with a chosen stylist; length set by the service, and by answers for color
pf.services.examples: the example salon's own prices (Lee Hair Studio and Lee Mobile Hair), not a standard

pf.services.capacity: one stylist per booking; a bridal party is one booking with several people and one code
pf.services.skills: cut, color, extensions, bridal and updos, makeup; color services offer only stylists who do color
pf.services.online: no: hair work is done in person
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the customer must be there

beforeTimes: the service, and for color: the natural color and length now
any color, box dye, henna or bleach in the last 2 years
for a big change (2 or more levels lighter, a first balayage or highlights): a consult first
for a bridal party: how many people, and the date
afterTime: anything the stylist should know (thick or long hair, a style to keep)
for a house call or venue: the address, parking and a room with a chair, light and a plug
securePage: scalp sore, irritated or broken now
goal photos and photos of the hair now
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18 (and a parent's OK for color or chemical services on a minor where the state's rules require it)

stop.words: a dye reaction happening now: face, lips or throat swelling, hard to breathe
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rinse the dye off with plenty of water.

stop.words: a burn or blisters on the scalp after a chemical service
stop.say: Rinse with cool water and see a doctor today. The salon is told at once.
stop.booking: no booking until a doctor says it's OK

goOn.words: scalp irritated, sunburned, cut or infected
goOn.what: no color, relaxer or other chemical on it; the stylist checks the scalp and the patch-test spot before mixing; the visit goes on as a cut, or moves at no fee

pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Patch test (a small skin test for a reaction to hair dye)
steps.when: at least 48 hours before permanent color, the time the product label sets
steps.who: new color clients, and anyone whose last test has run out
steps.goodFor: 3 months (the example salon's rule), or until the product line changes
steps.result: the customer reports the spot on the secure page 48 hours after; redness or itching calls the color off with a full refund; no answer: the stylist checks the spot in the chair

steps.name: Consult and patch test
steps.when: at least 48 hours before a big change (2 or more levels lighter, a first balayage or highlights)
steps.result: the stylist sets the final price; the customer says yes, or cancels with a full refund

steps.name: Consult for color correction
steps.result: priced at the chair; often 2 or more visits

steps.name: Bridal hair trial
steps.when: before the wedding day (the owner's setting)
steps.result: the look and the timing for the day are saved for the stylist

pf.first_steps.reaction: a past reaction to hair dye: book only the consult and patch test, with Sam's OK; the color is decided after the test
pf.first_steps.prep: for the reminder: bring goal photos; tell the salon on the secure page about any change to the scalp; for a house call, a chair near a plug and good light

pf.visit.checkIn: at the salon: the check-in code at the front desk or the chair; at a home or venue: the code from whoever will be there (the bride or the venue contact when a mobile is given for them)
pf.visit.beforeWork: the stylist checks the scalp and the patch-test spot before mixing color, and goes over any price set at a consult or from photos before work starts
pf.visit.changes: extra work (a toner, a treatment, a bang trim) is priced and OK'd before it's done; long color is booked as one whole block, with processing time
pf.visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the stylist; the color formula and photos go in the stylist's notes for next time

pf.money.before: a card saved for cuts; a deposit for long color ($40 for the Highlights package, the example salon's amount), counted toward the bill; the $25 consult as a deposit on color correction, a long color priced at the chair (never more than its starting price); deposits for bridal parties (25%)
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting; many salons pick 48 hours for long color and bridal work)
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $20 ($40 for the Highlights package); the owner confirms each fee, never more than what was agreed
pf.money.refunds: a full refund if the consult or patch test rules color out, or the salon changes the plan
pf.money.tips: on: at the chair, or a tip line on the bill Rosie texts; tips go to the stylist
pf.money.tax: a tax line for products sold, where the state's rules require it

pf.messages.never: allergy, dye-reaction, patch-test and scalp answers never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record
pf.messages.minors: a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.licenses: each stylist's license per state; makeup where the state licenses it
pf.staff.skills: cut, color, extensions, bridal and updos, makeup; only stylists who do color are offered for color
pf.staff.supervision: apprentices and students work only under a licensed stylist, where the state's rules allow
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs every color quote, new-client color of 3 hours or more, and a past dye reaction
pf.staff.standIn: a stand-in gets the consult notes, the color formula and the patch-test date
pf.staff.away: only stylists cleared for work away from the salon are offered for house calls and venues

pf.rules.showLicense: the license is shown where the state asks: posted at the salon, and in the text before a house call
pf.rules.away: work away from the salon only where the state allows it, and only for the services it allows (a switch from the state form)
pf.rules.receipt: what a receipt must show (the license number, the board's contact) where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.minors: a parent's written OK for chemical services on a minor, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.records: color formulas and patch-test dates kept with the customer's record: 7 years, or longer where the state asks
pf.rules.contracts: a signed contract for bridal party work (the owner's setting), and where the state's rules require one above an amount

pf.edges.lateArrival: 15 minutes' grace; later, the stylist decides if long color still fits; a rebook moves the deposit with no fee
pf.edges.standIn: a stylist out sick: a stand-in who does that service, with the notes, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.patchTest: a patch test not done in time: later times that keep the 48 hours, or a cut only
pf.edges.reaction: a reaction after the visit: aftercare tips, and Sam is told at once
pf.edges.fix: a free toner fix within 7 days of a color visit (the example salon's promise)
pf.edges.runsLong: color runs long: the next customer is told the new start
pf.edges.party: a bridal party: one booking, several people, one check-in code
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

Plug-in facts: photos, firststeps, forms, extrawork, groups, children. Switches: none (cancelright off: no contract is signed at home for a cut; sensitive off: health answers stay on the secure page, S13-05). Settings: arrive setstart in flow A, window in flow B; cutoff 24 hours before.

Flow B money: list|card|bill (main; $179 cut and style at home; a card saved for the $89 visit fee; the bill after), list|card|card ($179, charged to the saved card when DONE), photos|deposit|bill (bridal party hair from photos, $640: $160 deposit, $480 rest on the bill, $89 fee), photos|deposit|card (the $480 rest charged to the saved card when DONE, never on a set day), list|full|none ($150 bridal hair trial, paid in full), visit|card|bill (extensions styling priced at the visit; a card saved for the $89 fee).
Removed in this refit: all legacy money words ops (vary keys by price, before, after), dead off ops, the "rest on a set day before the wedding" line, the "$40 fee held" and "$89 held" wording (a card is saved instead), the old haircut-plan words, the S1-29 off branch that no longer exists. Kept: the master words the hair work uses (haircut, color, color correction, color and cut, kids cut, dye, gloss, perm, cape, patch test, house call, cut hair, leak).
Licenses: optional wording only; never checked by Rosie (D96). The house-call license rule (pf.license.away) is the business's own switch; not a fact here.
Children: 'kids cut' is kept as a service; the rating split: 'No: named-only work' is off (every finished visit asks a rating).
